observational_unit: island flora assembled from a multi-species source pool

biological_kernel.generalization: effective visitor-access width = visitor_breadth + generalization_span * species_accessibility
biological_kernel.display: visitor-specific attraction multiplier = baseline_attraction + visitor_display_sensitivity * species_display
biological_kernel.display_filtering: visitor reach scale = base_visitor_reach_scale * exp(-display_dispersal_penalty * visitor_display_sensitivity)
biological_kernel.occupancy: logistic(colonization_intercept + log(seed_reach) + establishment_strength*(viable_reproduction - establishment_threshold) + fixed source-availability offset)

training.shared_scale_rule: fit exactly one nonnegative scale each for assurance, accessibility and display, shared across the 4 H1 and 4 H2 coefficients of that domain
training.H3_rule: direct comparison in pollen-limitation LRR units; use empirical SE for z-error
training.H4_rule: direct species-level coefficient comparison; use empirical SE for z-errors
sign_gates: H1 assurance > 0 in all four strata
H1 accessibility > 0 in all four strata
H2 accessibility_given_assurance > 0 in all four strata
training.score: assurance NRMSE + accessibility NRMSE + display NRMSE + H3 z_error^2 + H4 assurance z_error^2 + H4 accessibility z_error^2
training.acceptance: eligible if sign gates pass and score <= 8.0; freeze best eight before opening Direct-only targets
training.eligibility: every pseudo-island must have expected flora richness (sum of species occupancy probabilities) >= 10
training.extinction_handling: parameter sets with any pseudo-island below the richness floor are ineligible; islands are not dropped from regressions

held_out.scales: reuse all-analysis training scales without refitting
parameter_set_success: scaled display prediction positive in northern_high_latitude, tropical and southern_extratropical
scaled H2 display prediction negative in northern_high_latitude and positive in tropical and southern_extratropical
held_out.overall_success: at least 5 of the 8 frozen accepted parameter sets pass; best all-analysis training set must pass
held_out.no_retuning: Direct-only outcomes cannot alter source pool, visitor pool, search ranges, score threshold or training scales in v2

claim_boundary: v2 emulates flora composition and species-level pollen limitation; it still does not reconstruct historical parameters for named regions.
display is a latent pollinator-facing investment axis, not literal flower colour.
visitor-specific display sensitivity is a mechanistic hypothesis tested through held-out evidence, not an observed pollinator-guild reconstruction.
within-lineage evolution is not yet included in v2; v2 tests whether species sorting plus reproductive filtering can reproduce the Chapter 1 macroecological syndrome.
